response.text: There are 2 unbalanced journals, 1 negative invoice, and 1 header with a non-null REF_JRNL_NO. Time to look at those, plus how AP invoice and payment journals are shaped.

arguments.sql: SELECT h.*, (SELECT string_agg(l."LN_SEQ"||':'||l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||':'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) OR h."REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (1000,1001,1006)
SELECT * FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 OR "JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "REF_JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NOT NULL)
SELECT "SRC_REF", count(*) n, min("JRNL_NO"), max("JRNL_NO"), min("MEMO"), max("MEMO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT "ACCT_CD", count(*), sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
